recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, wide-perspective shot of two men in the back seat of a vehicle, framed by the tops of blue leather seats. The composition features a dark, high-contrast environment with a central typographic lockup at the top and a secondary graphic badge in the bottom left.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical framing created by the two front seat headrests
Dynamic perspective from a low, wide-angle camera position
High-contrast lighting separating subjects from a deep black background
Textual elements anchored to the vertical center and bottom-left corner
coreInvariants: Blue vertical-ribbed leather seats in the foreground
Subjects holding clear plastic cups with amber liquid and ice
Deep black negative space in the upper third
Direct eye contact with the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects positioned in the mid-ground, filling the horizontal center; large scale relative to the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The beveled, wood-textured display text at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central text, moves down to the subjects' faces, follows the hands holding cups, and settles on the foreground seat texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space at the top provides a canvas for the primary logo.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Navy blue with white highlights on the leather seats.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber and wood tones in the text and beverages.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright white headwear/highlights and the dark environment; muted, earthy saturation in clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a heavy, beveled serif with a wood-grain texture and metallic inner glow
Secondary text uses a bold, rounded sans-serif with a thick white outline
Background graffiti-style element uses a thick, blue-grey stroke with rounded terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a textured, ornate serif with a clean, outlined sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Square border badge in bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Strong horizontal serifs and wide stance for primary text.
Matches the rounded, bold geometry of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle fisheye photograph of two men in streetwear sitting in the back of a car. The foreground is dominated by the tops of two navy blue leather seats with vertical stitching. The background is pitch black. The men are holding clear plastic cups with ice and amber liquid. High contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large beveled wood-textured serif title at the top center. Below it, add a smaller all-caps rounded sans-serif subtitle with a thick white outline. In the bottom left, place a small black square with white sans-serif text inside a white border.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective low-angle and wide?
Are the seats navy blue with vertical ribbing?
Does the top text have a 3D beveled appearance?

adjustableVariables: Texture of the primary display text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Specific graffiti tag shapes in the background
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the fisheye distortion feels intentional and not warped.
Verify the wood texture on the text is visible.
Check that the white outlines on the subtitle are crisp.
Confirm the bottom-left badge is perfectly square.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle urban portrait + symmetrical foreground framing + high-contrast black background + beveled/textured display typography.
